items.title: Hypolite Charles Interview, 1963-04-13
items.q: Man of mine, he's going to tell you, Peter Bocaz, young girl can tell you.

ctx.x: So when they applaud you always play the same number.

You know how much they was paying to play there? One dollar a night. Man of mine, he's going to tell you, Peter Bocaz, young girl can tell you. Because me, I wasn't playing regular there. I mean I used to go play like that in one another's place. Because like I'm telling you, I'm sorry I didn't go play there because if I was like where I lived, today I would be pretty well fixed up. Who were they? Oh yes indeed. Because those men used to come off the ship, come throw money on the floor just like if you were…
What's the biggest night you ever had for tips? Do you remember?
